pages.title: Legal information
pages.intro: Information about using Neuroartan and the choices available to you.

sections.title: Our notices
paragraphs: Read the Terms of Use for conditions of website access, the Privacy Policy for personal information, and the Cookie Policy for browser storage and preferences. These notices apply to their stated services; separate services may provide additional terms.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these notices, email contact@neuroartan.com.

pages.title: Cookie Policy
pages.intro: How browser storage supports your experience and how to manage your choices.

sections.title: Browser storage
paragraphs: Cookies and similar browser storage can support sign-in, security and preferences such as appearance or language. Necessary storage supports a function you request. Optional preferences depend on the choices offered by the relevant service.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: Use the available privacy controls to review optional choices. You can also remove stored website data through your browser settings. Removing session data may sign you out or reset preferences. Choosing not to save optional preferences should not prevent access to public information.

sections.title: Questions
paragraphs: Read the Privacy Policy for information about personal data and your rights. Contact contact@neuroartan.com with questions about storage or privacy controls.

pages.title: Operator information
pages.intro: Who is responsible for this website.

sections.title: Website operator
paragraphs: Neuroartan is operated by Artan Davoodi (legal name: Saeed Davoodi), based in Croatia. The Neuroartan name identifies the project and does not represent a separately registered company.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For website, legal or privacy enquiries, email contact@neuroartan.com. Please do not include passwords, payment-card details or identity documents in an initial enquiry.

pages.title: Data and privacy
pages.intro: Find information about personal data and how to raise a privacy request.

sections.title: Privacy requests
paragraphs: Email contact@neuroartan.com to ask about access, correction, deletion, objection, restriction, portability or withdrawing consent where applicable. Describe the service and request without including more personal information than necessary. Identity checks may be needed before account information can be disclosed or changed.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: The Privacy Policy describes categories of personal information, processing purposes, legal bases, recipients, retention criteria and available rights. Rights and legal obligations depend on the circumstances and applicable law.

pages.title: Acceptable use
pages.intro: Use Neuroartan responsibly and respect other people and their work.

sections.title: Responsible use
paragraphs: Do not attempt unauthorized access, compromise accounts, distribute malicious software, impersonate others, harass people or use the service unlawfully. Only submit material you are authorized to use. Do not upload another person's confidential or sensitive information without a lawful basis.

sections.title: Applicable terms
paragraphs: The Terms of Use govern access and describe possible restrictions following misuse. Nothing in this notice removes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

pages.title: Service information
pages.intro: Understand the scope of information and services presented on this website.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: Product descriptions explain their stated capabilities and direction. Availability depends on the specific service and access offered. A description or demonstration does not itself create a purchase contract or promise access to every feature.

sections.title: Information and professional advice
paragraphs: Website information is not a substitute for qualified medical, legal or financial advice. Use the Terms of Use and any service-specific information to understand applicable conditions. Contact contact@neuroartan.com if information appears inaccurate.

pages.title: Policies
pages.intro: Website terms and privacy information in one place.

sections.title: Privacy
paragraphs: The Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled. The Cookie Policy explains browser storage and preference choices.

sections.title: Website use
paragraphs: The Terms of Use and Acceptable Use notice explain access conditions and responsible conduct. Additional terms may apply to a specific service when clearly presented before use.

pages.title: Brand and intellectual property
pages.intro: Respect Neuroartan names, designs and published work.

sections.title: Rights in content
paragraphs: Neuroartan names, logos, designs, text and other original materials may be protected by intellectual-property law. Public access does not transfer ownership or grant unrestricted permission to reuse them. No claim of registered trademark status is made by this notice.

sections.title: Permissions
paragraphs: Contact contact@neuroartan.com to request permission for uses beyond rights provided by applicable law or an express licence. Do not imply endorsement or affiliation without authorization.
